embeds.title: ARTICLE XII — STARTUP DRAFT
embeds.description:
The working startup format is a **36-round slow snake draft** with a **4-hour pick clock**.

A nightly sleep window runs from **12:00 AM through 8:00 AM ET**. Picks may be made during the sleep window where Fantrax allows, but the active clock is paused.

Draft queues are strongly encouraged. After two timer expirations, Fantrax auto-draft behavior may be used until the manager returns.

Final startup mechanics remain subject to the tested Fantrax configuration before the inaugural draft begins.
